z-m-25-09.title: Ingaba i-P(1) ne-P(3) zodwa zinokumisela intsalela?
z-m-25-09.topic: Ithiyori yentsalela: ulwazi olumisela intsalela ibe yinye
z-m-25-09.goal: Hlula ulwazi onokusetyenziswa ukumisela intsalela kolo lungenakusetyenziswa, uze uphikise impazamo ngokwenza iintsalela ezahlukileyo eziyanelisa ulwazi olufanayo.
z-m-25-09.material: Intsalela R(x) xa ipholinomiyali P(x) ihlulwa ngu-(x−1)(x−2) yintetho yohlobo ax+b yedigri ye-1 ubuninzi. Intetho ye-P(x) ayaziwa, kwaye ngamanye amaxabiso emisebenzi ye-P(x) kuphela anokunikwa. (a no-b ziinani zangempela)
z-m-25-09.prereq.1: Uyayazi intetho yokwahlula ipholinomiyali P(x)=B(x)Q(x)+R(x) nedigri yentsalela.
z-m-25-09.prereq.2: Uyayazi ithiyori yentsalela (intsalela xa P(x) ihlulwa ngu-x−a yi-P(a)).
z-m-25-09.s.s1.prompt: Loluphi kolu lulandelayo ulwazi olumisela intsalela R(x) ibe yinye?
z-m-25-09.s.s1.hint.0: Kwi-P(x)=(x−1)(x−2)Q(x)+ax+b, faka amaxabiso aziwayo e-x uze ujonge into eyenzekayo kwigama elinesiphumo sokwahlula Q(x).
z-m-25-09.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ukuba zingaphi ii-equation ku-a no-b onokuzimisela ukusuka kulwazi kukhetho ngalunye.
z-m-25-09.s.s1.r.a: Cinga ukuba a no-b zimiselwe zibe zinye xa kukho ulwazi olunye kuphela. Zininzi (a, b) ezine-a+b=3.
z-m-25-09.s.s1.r.b: Esi sigwebo sisebenzisa ulwazi kumaxabiso amabini enza umahluli (x−1)(x−2) abe ngu-0.
z-m-25-09.s.s1.r.c: Oku kusenokuba sisigwebo esasebenzisa ulwazi kwi-x=3, engelilo ixabiso elenza umahluli abe ngu-0, ngqo kwintsalela. Hlola ukuba inxalenye yesiphumo sokwahlula yentetho yokwahlula iba ngu-0 kwi-x=3.
z-m-25-09.s.s1.r.d: Olu lulwazi olungenawo onke amaxabiso enza umahluli abe ngu-0. Cinga ukuba ungamisela ii-equation ku-a no-b ngolu lwazi.
z-m-25-09.s.s1.explain: Kwi-P(x)=(x−1)(x−2)Q(x)+ax+b, ukufaka x=1 no-x=2 kususa impembelelo yesiphumo sokwahlula, ngoko P(1)=a+b kunye ne-P(2)=2a+b. Ukuba uyawazi la maxabiso mabini, a no-b zimiselwe (a=2, b=1).
z-m-25-09.s.s2.prompt: Umfundi wafumana intsalela esebenzisa kuphela 'P(1)=3, P(3)=7'. Khetha umgca ongachanekanga kwisisombululo.

z-m-25-09.s.s2.line.0: Ukuba isiphumo sokwahlula xa P(x) ihlulwa ngu-(x−1)(x−2) yi-Q(x) kwaye intsalela yi-ax+b, ngoko P(x)=(x−1)(x−2)Q(x)+ax+b.
z-m-25-09.s.s2.line.1: Ukufaka x=1 kunika P(1)=a+b, ngoko a+b=3.
z-m-25-09.s.s2.line.3: Ukusombulula ii-equation ezimbini kunika a=2, b=1, ngoko intsalela yi-2x+1.
z-m-25-09.s.s2.explain: Kumgca 3, xa x=3 ifakwe, (x−1)(x−2)Q(3)=2Q(3) ayingo-0, kodwa igama elinesiphumo sokwahlula lalahlwa. Ngoko 3a+b=7 isenokungasebenzi. Isigqibo somgca 4 sixhomekeke koku nasi.
z-m-25-09.s.s3.prompt: Zikho iipholinomiyali ezine-P(1)=3 kunye ne-P(3)=7 ezintsalela yazo ingeyo-2x+1. Xa intsalela yi-ax+b, yenza (a, b) ezi-3 ezahlukileyo apho ipholinomiyali enjalo inokubakho. (Khupha imeko a=2.)
z-m-25-09.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale ubudlelwane obuvela phakathi kuka-a no-b xa ubhala i-P(1)=3 ngokwentsalela.
z-m-25-09.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuba i-P(3)=7 inokwanelisa na ukuba uthatha isiphumo sokwahlula Q njengekhonstanti.
z-m-25-09.s.s3.fail.c1: Hlola kwakhona ukuba a+b kufuneka ibe yintoni ukuze P(1)=3.
z-m-25-09.s.s3.fail.c2: Ukuba a=2, ngoko b=1 kwaye yi-2x+1. Fumana amanye amaxabiso.
z-m-25-09.s.s3.explain: Ukuthatha i-P(x)=(x−1)(x−2)Q+ax+b (Q yikhonstanti), P(1)=a+b=3 kunye ne-P(3)=2Q+3a+b=7. Ukuba a+b=3, unokuhambelana nge-Q=2−a, ngoko nokuba a ayiyi-2, zikho iipholinomiyali eziyanelisa zombini iimeko.
